title: USPS label request bodies as built by App\Services\Carriers\UspsAdapter
description: Hand-written from our own adapter code, not from USPS's published spec, which cannot be vendored — see README.md. Each definition names the adapter method that builds it. Every object closes with additionalProperties:false, so a renamed or newly added key fails here until this file is updated to match; that is the point.

LabelRequest.description: Body of App\Http\Integrations\USPS\Requests\Label (POST /labels/v3/label), built by UspsAdapter::createDomesticShipment(). customsForm appears only for APO/FPO/DPO destinations, which cross a customs boundary on a domestic label.

InternationalLabelRequest.description: Body of App\Http\Integrations\USPS\Requests\InternationalLabel (POST /international-labels/v3/international-label), built by UspsAdapter::createInternationalShipment(). The destination is an international address; the origin stays domestic. A customs form is always sent.

DomesticAddress.description: UspsAdapter::buildDomesticAddress(). ZIPCode is the first five characters of the postal code and is a string, never a number. The party is named either by firstName and lastName together or by firm; addNameFields() folds a lone first or last name into firm.

InternationalAddress.description: UspsAdapter::buildInternationalAddress(). country and countryISOAlpha2Code both carry the same two-letter code. province and postalCode are sent only when the address has them. Names follow the same rule as DomesticAddress.

PackageDescription.description: Shared by both label bodies. mailClass, rateIndicator and processingCategory are copied from the selected rate's metadata; weight and dimensions are numbers in pounds and inches; extraServices is a list of USPS numeric service codes from mapExtraServices(). customerReference comes from buildCustomerReference(), packageOptions and contentType from mapExtraServices(), and each is omitted rather than sent empty.

CustomerReference.description: One entry of UspsAdapter::buildCustomerReference(). The reference is cut to 30 characters and always asked to print.

PackageOptions.description: UspsAdapter::mapExtraServices(). packageValue accompanies insurance (930/931); physicalSignatureRequired accompanies a signature or high-value insurance service (921/922/931). Sent only when at least one applies.

CustomsForm.description: UspsAdapter::buildCustomsForm(). invoiceNumber repeats the first label reference, since that is what USPS prints on the form. Item values and weights are totals for the line, not per unit.

CustomsContentItem.description: One line of the customs form. itemQuantity is an integer; HSTariffNumber is a string and is omitted when the item has none. Note the field is spelled countryofOrigin, with a lower-case 'of'.

ImageInfo.description: UspsAdapter::createDomesticShipment() / createInternationalShipment(). imageType is sent only for ZPL output; PDF is the API's default and is requested by leaving it out.
